subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch its primary display to full local date/time, with relative time only as secondary context?
rationale: The source path is clear, but this is a user-visible table-density and timestamp-format choice rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Use full date/time primary
options.body: Adopt or replace the linked PR with a narrow UI change that shows full local date/time in the Updated column and keeps relative time as hover context.

options.title: Keep relative primary
options.body: Keep the current compact relative display and consider adding exact date/time only in tooltip or row details.

options.title: Decline the change
options.body: Close the request as not planned if maintainers prefer the current compact Sessions table behavior.

recommendation.title: Use full date/time primary
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the linked PR with a narrow UI change that shows full local date/time in the Updated column and keeps relative time as hover context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership and blame for the Sessions view make this the best routing candidate for the UI policy decision.
